first_red.effect: The replacement candidate would still consume fixed C2 domains before ownership even though the explicit C2 prepare/boot calls had moved.

root_cause.mechanism: The first ordering fix moved only the visibly C2-named consumers. The staged boot overlay is also a C2 shelf consumer in the product cut.

required_fix_and_gate.product_fix: Move ownership before the complete staged-overlay operation, not merely before c2_product_prepare_boot and c2_product_boot.
required_fix_and_gate.permanent_gate: Generate the fixed-domain consumer closure from the linked product and bind the source-order boundary; mutations for late ownership and newly added pre-handoff consumers must fail.
required_fix_and_gate.hardware_recheck: Only a fully gated fresh candidate may reach the receipt-less hardware pre-smoke.

claim_limit: Static first-red only. Link 22 did not complete the structural report set and never reached hardware, promotion or acceptance.
